title: Eliphaz Speaks: Job, You Condemn Yourself

questions.question: Who answers Job in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Job 15:1 (ESV): "Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said:"

questions.question: Should a wise man answer with what kind of knowledge?
questions.explanation: Job 15:2 (ESV): "Should a wise man answer with windy knowledge, and fill his belly with the east wind?"

questions.question: What does Eliphaz say Job's own mouth does?
questions.explanation: Job 15:6 (ESV): "Your own mouth condemns you, and not I; your own lips testify against you."

questions.question: Are you the first man who was what?
questions.explanation: Job 15:7 (ESV): "Are you the first man who was born? Or were you brought forth before the hills?"

questions.question: What writhes in pain all his days?
questions.explanation: Job 15:20 (ESV): "The wicked man writhes in pain all his days..."

questions.question: What does Eliphaz ask Job about his knowledge?
options: What do you know that we do not know?
questions.correctAnswer: What do you know that we do not know?
questions.explanation: Job 15:9 (ESV): "What do you know that we do not know? What do you understand that is not clear to us?"

questions.question: Are the comforts of God too what for you?
questions.explanation: Job 15:11 (ESV): "Are the comforts of God too small for you, or the word that deals gently with you?"

questions.question: What is man, that he can be what?
questions.explanation: Job 15:14 (ESV): "What is man, that he can be pure? Or he who is born of a woman, that he can be righteous?"

questions.question: God puts no trust in his what?
questions.explanation: Job 15:15 (ESV): "Behold, God puts no trust in his holy ones, and the heavens are not pure in his sight;"

questions.question: A sound of what is in the ears of the wicked?
questions.explanation: Job 15:21 (ESV): "A sound of dread is in his ears; in peace the destroyer will come upon him."

questions.question: He wanders abroad for bread, saying what?
questions.explanation: Job 15:23 (ESV): "He wanders abroad for bread, saying, 'Where is it?'"

questions.question: Because he has stretched out his hand against whom?
questions.explanation: Job 15:25 (ESV): "Because he has stretched out his hand against God and defies the Almighty,"

questions.question: He will not depart from what?
questions.explanation: Job 15:30 (ESV): "he will not depart from darkness; the flame will dry up his shoots..."

questions.question: Let him not trust in emptiness, deceiving himself, for emptiness will be his what?
questions.explanation: Job 15:31 (ESV): "Let him not trust in emptiness, deceiving himself, for emptiness will be his payment."

questions.question: Fire will consume the tents of whom?
questions.explanation: Job 15:34 (ESV): "For the company of the godless is barren, and fire consumes the tents of bribery."

key_verse_text: Behold, God puts no trust in his holy ones, and the heavens are not pure in his sight;
